sources.entry: MangoDisk - Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer with local scanning and review before deletion.

summary.one_liner: MangoDisk is an open-source disk cleanup, storage analysis, and privacy cleaning app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with a companion command-line tool.
summary.what_it_does: It scans the system, applications, browsers, developer tools, containers, AI model caches, and local projects for cleanable content and groups results by reclaimable space. It also finds large files and exact duplicate files (keeping at least one copy per group), and offers a treemap or sunburst view for disk space analysis. Additional tools cover privacy trace cleanup, application uninstall with leftover removal, startup item management, and built-in system optimization and maintenance settings. The README says scans are read-only by default and that changes are shown for confirmation and recorded in an Operation History. A CLI exposes a clean command that only scans unless --apply and --yes are passed, and it can output JSON. Optional AI explanations describe items, with daily free explanations in official releases and the option to use your own AI service.
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac or PC
find large files and old installers
analyze which folders use the most storage
clean developer caches from Xcode, Docker, and package managers
uninstall apps and remove leftover files
how_to_run: git clone <repo-url> && cd MangoDisk && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm tauri:dev
notable: Safety-first design: read-only scans by default, review before any deletion, and an Operation History log
Cleanup rules are declarative, build-validated TOML files with a public rule library
System optimization uses only built-in validated settings and re-reads each setting after changing it
Treemap and sunburst views for exploring disk usage
Menu bar, taskbar, or tray display of CPU, memory, network, and disk activity
caveats: Cleanup, permanent deletion, and uninstall may not be reversible; the README advises keeping backups
Linux CLI has no prebuilt standalone download and must be built from source; Linux compatibility beyond Ubuntu depends on system libraries
Requires macOS Monterey 12.5 or later, or 64-bit Windows 10 or later for the desktop app
